name: Troy
title: Hudson River Paddling Conditions Near Troy, NY
blurb: The Ingalls Avenue launch, a quarter mile below the federal dam — the top of the tidal Hudson. Above the dam the river is locked and the tide stops.

tide.label: NOAA TEC1603 Troy
tide.note: Tide from NOAA station TEC1603, which NOAA calls Troy, about two miles downriver.
tide.cardNote: Unless you plan on landing on a beach or poking into a shallow creek, tide is likely not very important to you.

current.label: NOAA HUR0618_8 Port of Albany
current.note: Current from NOAA station HUR0618_8 (Port of Albany), nine miles downriver — the nearest one on the river. Flood and ebb headings are the river’s own axis here, not the station’s: the river runs more nearly north at Troy than it does at Albany.
